solvedLongTermMemory.title: Execution Delay & Queue Latency Modeling
solvedLongTermMemory.description: Ensure executionDelayMs is non-zero, reflects lognormal jitter (25ms-180ms), and models order arrival queue delays.

solvedLongTermMemory.title: Lookahead Bias in Intra-Bar Indicator Snapshots
solvedLongTermMemory.description: Features were referencing closing candle states rather than point-in-time closed bar indicators at signal creation.
solvedLongTermMemory.resolutionNote: Strict closed-bar shift-1 verification and nanosecond snapshot serialization implemented.

solvedLongTermMemory.title: Zero-Slippage Simulation on Altcoin Order Books
solvedLongTermMemory.description: Altcoin contracts (XRP, SOL, HYPE) were clearing without liquidity-tiered depth degradation or slippage.
solvedLongTermMemory.resolutionNote: Four-tier liquidity model (2.5 to 32 bps) and square-root size impact formula deployed.

solvedLongTermMemory.title: Unmeasured Adverse Selection & Toxic Flow Markouts
solvedLongTermMemory.description: Post-fill trade price paths were unmonitored, allowing executions into adverse selection without detection.
solvedLongTermMemory.resolutionNote: Asynchronous 1s, 5s, and 60s post-fill markout tracker with toxic flow alert threshold added.

solvedLongTermMemory.title: Directional Monoculture 100% YES Long Bias
solvedLongTermMemory.description: Trading engine clustered into 100% YES contract executions regardless of macro regime.
solvedLongTermMemory.resolutionNote: USDT.D macro expansion gatekeeper and 4-trade consecutive long circuit breaker deployed.
